0022600130.text: The Spurs (1-2, 10th in the West) host the Sacramento Kings (0-2, 14th in the West) in San Antonio's fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Spurs 0-2 at home and 1-0 on the road. Sacramento is on a two-game losing streak, and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance and Tobias Harris, while the Kings are missing Ben Simmons, Dylan Cardwell and Maxime Raynaud. The teams have not played each other yet this season, but the Spurs swept all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently beating Sacramento 132-104 in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
